name: Zorofin
description: Seerr requests, play history with an Activity page, popular-this-week stats and server announcements.
overview: Optional server features for Jellyfin and the Zorofin apps.

versions.changelog: First public release, installable from the plugin repository manifest. - Home rows refresh from 1.5: a per-viewer cache so Home opens faster, and rows driven by TMDB and your library. - Sports: the "Your teams" row only appears when one of your favorite teams is playing now or within the hour, and its cards carry the matchup and both team crests. - Playback problem reports: the apps can send a report (with the stream and device details) to the Support tab. - Notification read state is kept per account, so reading a notification on one device clears it on the others. - Catch Up: Like or Skip, sharing taste with recommendations. - Plays that end without a matching stop report are still saved to play history. - "Recommended to request" titles picked by AI (optional, your own key) and by what viewers actually watch.
